card.name: Space before a dose or eGFR number
card.fires_on: The space (or small linking word) right before a number in diabetes-drug labels, mainly after eGFR thresholds like 'less than' or dose phrases like 'is' and 'increased to'.

modes.label: eGFR cutoff
modes.description: Space after 'less than' or 'below' just before an eGFR value such as 45 or 30.
modes.example: m2. Dapagliflozin and saxagliptin tablets are contraindicated in patients with an eGFR less than<< >>45 mL/min/1.7

modes.label: Dose amount
modes.description: Space after 'dosage is' or 'increased to' just before a mg amount.
modes.example: existing NYHA Class I or II congestive heart failure, the recommended starting dosage of alogliptin and pioglitazone tablets is<< >>25 mg of aloglipt

modes.label: Linking word or bracket
modes.description: A linking word or opening bracket in section headings and cross-references.
